nodes.label: Document Upload Approval Chain
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical verification chain: Task Force Upload -> Dean Approval -> IQA Authorization.

nodes.label: Stage 1: Preparation & Application
nodes.rationale: Task Force formation and formal accreditation intent filing.

nodes.label: Stage 2: Self-Survey & Document Consolidation
nodes.rationale: Task Force uploads documents, runs OCR, and links evidence to AACCUP criteria.

nodes.label: Stage 3: Dean Review & Endorsement
nodes.rationale: College Dean verifies evidence completeness and formally endorses the application.

nodes.label: Stage 4: IQA Preliminary Evaluation
nodes.rationale: IQA Staff audits college submissions for baseline compliance before mock review.

nodes.label: Stage 6: Revision & Action Plan Execution
nodes.rationale: Task Force addresses internal accreditor findings and uploads deficiency evidence.

nodes.label: Stage 7: Final Submission to AACCUP
nodes.rationale: IQA locks evidence portfolio and transmits formal documents to AACCUP survey team.

nodes.label: Stage 8: Actual Survey Visit
nodes.rationale: External Accreditors inspect campus, interview stakeholders, and score parameters.

nodes.label: Stage 9: Post-Survey & Continuous Compliance
nodes.rationale: IQA tracks compliance action plans and post-accreditation improvements.

nodes.label: College Dean
nodes.rationale: Approves college-level evidence uploads, elevated to Task Force lead, endorses survey applications.

nodes.label: External Accreditor
nodes.rationale: Formal AACCUP evaluation team member granted read-only access strictly after formal submission.

nodes.label: Internal Accreditor
nodes.rationale: Rehearsal/mock review panel member who evaluates evidence and provides advisory feedback prior to formal submission.

nodes.label: IQA Staff / IQA Member
nodes.rationale: Central quality assurance officer exclusively managing and authorizing all 9 stage transitions in the accreditation pipeline.

nodes.label: System Administrator
nodes.rationale: Configures colleges, programs, user accounts, and oversees security & compliance audit logs.

nodes.label: Task Force Member
nodes.rationale: Program-level subject matter expert who uploads evidence and maps documents against AACCUP areas and criteria.

nodes.label: External Services Layer
nodes.rationale: Google Workspace OAuth 2.0 institutional SSO (@bicol-u.edu.ph) and Dual OCR Engine (Tesseract + Cloud Vision).

nodes.label: Dual-Driver OCR Engine Adapter
nodes.rationale: Dual-driver adapter supporting Google Cloud Vision API in production with local Tesseract fallback.

nodes.label: Tier 1: Frontend SPA (Inertia.js + Vue 3)
nodes.rationale: Inertia.js server-driven SPA with Vue 3 Composition API, Tailwind CSS v4, Shadcn Vue, DaisyUI.

nodes.label: Tier 2: Backend Application Core (Laravel 13 MVC)
nodes.rationale: Controller -> Service -> Eloquent Model / Policy pipeline with RBAC and college multi-tenancy.

nodes.label: Tier 3: Database & Cloud Storage (MySQL 8 + S3)
nodes.rationale: Laravel Cloud Managed MySQL 8 3NF schema and private Cloud Object Storage (S3) with 15-minute temporary signed URLs.

nodes.label: User / Workstation Browser
nodes.rationale: Desktop workstation (>= 1024px) for complex accreditation matrices and split-screen OCR validation.
